title: Cholera
description: Acute watery diarrhoeal illness from Vibrio cholerae; profuse rice-water stools, risk of rapid severe dehydration.

title: Diarrhoea due to Escherichia coli
description: Bacterial gastroenteritis from pathogenic E. coli strains; watery or bloody diarrhoea, cramping.

title: Typhoid fever
description: Systemic Salmonella Typhi infection; sustained fever, relative bradycardia, abdominal pain, rose spots.

title: Diphtheria
description: Corynebacterium diphtheriae infection with pseudomembrane formation; sore throat, fever, grey pharyngeal membrane.

title: Pertussis
description: Bordetella pertussis infection; paroxysmal coughing fits with inspiratory whoop, worse at night.

title: Leptospirosis
description: Zoonotic spirochete infection from contaminated water/animal urine exposure; fever, myalgia, jaundice, conjunctival suffusion.

title: Urinary schistosomiasis
description: Schistosoma haematobium infection; terminal haematuria, dysuria, endemic freshwater exposure.

title: Intestinal schistosomiasis
description: Schistosoma mansoni/japonicum infection; abdominal pain, bloody diarrhoea, hepatosplenomegaly over time.

title: Ascariasis
description: Intestinal roundworm infection; abdominal discomfort, may cause bowel or biliary obstruction in heavy loads.

title: Hookworm disease
description: Intestinal parasitic infection causing chronic blood loss; iron deficiency anaemia, fatigue, abdominal pain.

title: Tuberculosis of lung
description: Chronic mycobacterial lung infection; cough over 2 weeks, haemoptysis, night sweats, weight loss.

title: Tuberculous meningitis
description: Mycobacterial CNS infection; subacute headache, fever, meningism, cranial nerve palsies.

title: Leprosy
description: Mycobacterium leprae infection; hypopigmented anaesthetic skin patches, peripheral nerve thickening.

title: Cellulitis
description: Bacterial infection of skin and subcutaneous tissue; localized erythema, warmth, swelling, tenderness.

title: Erysipelas
description: Superficial streptococcal skin infection with sharply demarcated, raised, erythematous plaque.

title: Tetanus
description: Clostridium tetani toxin-mediated disease; trismus, muscle rigidity, spasms following a contaminated wound.

title: Bacterial meningitis
description: Acute bacterial CNS infection; fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, photophobia, altered mental status.

title: Viral meningitis
description: Viral CNS infection, generally milder course than bacterial; headache, fever, neck stiffness, no focal deficit.

title: Herpes zoster
description: Reactivation of varicella-zoster virus; painful unilateral dermatomal vesicular rash.

title: Herpes simplex virus infection
description: HSV infection causing painful grouped vesicles on erythematous base, oral or genital sites.

title: Sepsis
description: Life-threatening organ dysfunction from dysregulated host response to infection.

title: Influenza due to identified seasonal influenza virus
description: Abrupt fever, myalgia, headache, dry cough, fatigue during known seasonal circulation.

title: COVID-19
description: SARS-CoV-2 infection; fever, cough, dyspnea, anosmia, variable severity from mild to critical respiratory failure.

title: Dengue
description: Flavivirus infection transmitted by Aedes mosquito; high fever, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, rash, risk of plasma leakage.

title: Malaria
description: Plasmodium infection transmitted by Anopheles mosquito; cyclical fever, chills, sweats, headache.

title: Severe malaria
description: Malaria with organ dysfunction: cerebral involvement, severe anaemia, acute kidney injury, or respiratory distress.

title: Onchocerciasis
description: Filarial infection transmitted by blackfly; itchy skin nodules, risk of visual impairment.

title: Candidiasis
description: Fungal infection from Candida species; may affect mucosa, skin, or be invasive/systemic in immunocompromised patients.

title: COVID-19 associated pneumonia
description: Lower respiratory infection secondary to SARS-CoV-2; bilateral infiltrates, hypoxia.

title: Necrotising fasciitis
description: Rapidly progressive soft-tissue infection with tissue necrosis; pain out of proportion to exam findings, systemic toxicity.

title: Malignant neoplasm of breast
description: Breast malignancy; palpable mass, skin/nipple changes, may be detected on screening.

title: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus or lung
description: Lung malignancy; chronic cough, haemoptysis, weight loss, often smoking-associated.

title: Malignant neoplasm of colon
description: Colorectal malignancy; change in bowel habit, rectal bleeding, iron deficiency anaemia, weight loss.

title: Malignant neoplasm of prostate
description: Prostate malignancy; often asymptomatic early, may cause urinary symptoms or be found on PSA screening.

title: Malignant neoplasm of cervix uteri
description: Cervical malignancy; abnormal vaginal bleeding, discharge, often HPV-associated.

title: Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
description: Malignant proliferation of lymphoid precursors; fatigue, bruising, infection susceptibility, cytopenias.

title: Hodgkin lymphoma
description: Lymphoid malignancy with Reed-Sternberg cells; painless lymphadenopathy, B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss).

title: Benign neoplasm of uterus (leiomyoma)
description: Uterine fibroid; may cause heavy menstrual bleeding, pelvic pressure, or be asymptomatic.

title: Lipoma
description: Benign fatty tumour of subcutaneous tissue; soft, mobile, painless mass.

title: Malignant neoplasm of oesophagus
description: Oesophageal malignancy; progressive dysphagia, weight loss, often solids before liquids.

title: Malignant neoplasm of stomach
description: Gastric malignancy; epigastric pain, early satiety, weight loss, may present with GI bleeding.

title: Malignant neoplasm of ovary
description: Ovarian malignancy; often vague bloating, pelvic pain, presents late, may have adnexal mass.

title: Malignant neoplasm of skin, unspecified (melanoma pattern)
description: Skin malignancy; changing pigmented lesion, asymmetry, irregular border, colour variation, diameter growth.

title: Neoplasm of uncertain behaviour, unspecified site
description: Lesion pending histological characterization; use only when biopsy/further workup is pending.

title: Multiple myeloma
description: Plasma cell malignancy; bone pain, pathological fractures, anaemia, renal impairment, hypercalcaemia.

title: Iron deficiency anaemia
description: Anaemia from insufficient iron for haemoglobin synthesis; fatigue, pallor, exertional dyspnea, low ferritin.

title: Vitamin B12 deficiency anaemia
description: Megaloblastic anaemia from B12 deficiency; fatigue, glossitis, peripheral neuropathy, paraesthesia.

title: Sickle cell disease
description: Haemoglobinopathy causing vaso-occlusive crises; recurrent severe pain episodes, chronic haemolytic anaemia.

title: Aplastic anaemia
description: Bone marrow failure causing pancytopenia; fatigue, bleeding, infection susceptibility.

title: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura
description: Autoimmune platelet destruction; easy bruising, petechiae, mucosal bleeding, isolated low platelets.

title: Haemophilia A
description: Factor VIII deficiency, X-linked; prolonged bleeding after injury, spontaneous haemarthroses.

title: Severe combined immunodeficiency
description: Congenital T- and B-cell defect; recurrent severe infections from early infancy.

title: Systemic lupus erythematosus
description: Multisystem autoimmune disease; malar rash, arthralgia, photosensitivity, renal involvement, serositis.

title: Antiphospholipid syndrome
description: Autoimmune hypercoagulable state; recurrent thrombosis and/or pregnancy loss with antiphospholipid antibodies.

title: Sjögren syndrome
description: Autoimmune exocrine gland dysfunction; dry eyes, dry mouth, may be primary or secondary to another autoimmune disease.

title: Type 1 diabetes mellitus
description: Autoimmune beta-cell destruction; polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss, risk of diabetic ketoacidosis.

title: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
description: Insulin resistance with relative deficiency; polyuria, polydipsia, fatigue, often overweight adult.

title: Diabetic ketoacidosis
description: Acute diabetes complication; hyperglycaemia, ketosis, metabolic acidosis, vomiting, Kussmaul breathing.

title: Hypothyroidism
description: Underactive thyroid; fatigue, cold intolerance, weight gain, constipation, bradycardia.

title: Hyperthyroidism
description: Excess thyroid hormone; weight loss, heat intolerance, tremor, tachycardia, anxiety.

title: Graves disease
description: Autoimmune hyperthyroidism; diffuse goitre, exophthalmos, thyroid-stimulating antibodies.

title: Cushing syndrome
description: Excess cortisol exposure; central obesity, moon facies, striae, proximal weakness, hypertension.

title: Addison disease
description: Primary adrenal insufficiency; fatigue, weight loss, hyperpigmentation, hypotension, hyponatraemia.

title: Rickets
description: Vitamin D deficiency in children causing defective bone mineralization; bowed legs, growth delay.

title: Protein-energy malnutrition, severe
description: Severe undernutrition; wasting or oedema, growth failure in children, immune compromise.

title: Kwashiorkor
description: Severe protein malnutrition with adequate calories; oedema, hepatomegaly, skin/hair changes.

title: Obesity
description: Excess adiposity above BMI threshold, associated with metabolic and cardiovascular risk.

title: Hyperlipidaemia
description: Elevated serum lipids, usually asymptomatic, identified on screening.

title: Hyperuricaemia
description: Elevated serum uric acid, may be asymptomatic or predispose to gout.

title: Hypokalaemia
description: Low serum potassium; muscle weakness, cramps, arrhythmia risk, often from GI losses or diuretics.

title: Vitamin D deficiency
description: Low vitamin D status; bone pain, muscle weakness, in children may progress to rickets.

title: Single episode depressive disorder
description: Depressed mood or anhedonia most of the day nearly every day for 2+ weeks, with somatic/cognitive symptoms.

title: Recurrent depressive disorder
description: Two or more depressive episodes separated by periods of normal mood.

title: Bipolar type I disorder
description: At least one manic episode, often with depressive episodes; elevated/irritable mood, decreased need for sleep, grandiosity.

title: Generalised anxiety disorder
description: Persistent excessive worry across domains for 6+ months with restlessness, fatigue, muscle tension.

title: Panic disorder
description: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with palpitations, dyspnea, fear of losing control, anticipatory anxiety.

title: Social anxiety disorder
description: Marked fear of social situations involving scrutiny by others, avoidance or endurance with intense distress.

title: Obsessive-compulsive disorder
description: Recurrent intrusive obsessions and/or repetitive compulsions, time-consuming and distressing.

title: Post-traumatic stress disorder
description: Re-experiencing, avoidance, and hyperarousal symptoms following exposure to a traumatic event.

title: Alcohol dependence
description: Pattern of compulsive alcohol use with tolerance, withdrawal, and impaired control over consumption.

title: Alcohol withdrawal
description: Autonomic hyperactivity, tremor, anxiety, and potential seizures/delirium following abrupt cessation in a dependent drinker.

title: Opioid dependence
description: Compulsive opioid use with tolerance and withdrawal syndrome on cessation.

title: Autism spectrum disorder
description: Neurodevelopmental condition with persistent deficits in social communication and restricted, repetitive behaviours.

title: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
description: Persistent pattern of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity interfering with function, onset in childhood.

title: Schizophrenia
description: Psychotic disorder with delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, persisting over 1 month.

title: Body dysmorphic disorder
description: Preoccupation with perceived defects in physical appearance not observable or slight to others.

title: Anorexia nervosa
description: Restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, with fear of weight gain and body image disturbance.

title: Bulimia nervosa
description: Recurrent binge eating followed by compensatory behaviours (vomiting, laxatives, excessive exercise).

title: Delirium
description: Acute, fluctuating disturbance of attention and awareness with an underlying medical cause.

title: Dementia due to Alzheimer disease
description: Progressive neurocognitive decline with memory impairment as an early prominent feature.

title: Cannabis dependence
description: Compulsive cannabis use with tolerance and impaired control, may include withdrawal symptoms on cessation.

title: Insomnia disorder
description: Persistent difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep with daytime impairment, not explained solely by another condition.

title: Obstructive sleep apnoea
description: Repeated upper airway obstruction during sleep; loud snoring, witnessed apnoeas, daytime somnolence.

title: Narcolepsy
description: Excessive daytime sleepiness with sleep attacks, may include cataplexy triggered by strong emotion.

title: Restless legs syndrome
description: Urge to move the legs, worse at rest and in the evening, relieved by movement.

title: Migraine
description: Recurrent moderate-severe headache, often unilateral pulsating, with photophobia/phonophobia and sometimes aura, nausea.

title: Tension-type headache
description: Bilateral pressing headache of mild-moderate intensity, not aggravated by routine physical activity.

title: Cluster headache
description: Severe unilateral periorbital pain in cyclical attacks, with ipsilateral autonomic features (lacrimation, rhinorrhoea, ptosis).

title: Cerebral infarction (ischaemic stroke)
description: Acute focal neurological deficit from cerebral ischaemia; sudden weakness, speech disturbance, facial droop.

title: Non-traumatic intracerebral haemorrhage
description: Spontaneous bleeding into brain parenchyma; sudden severe headache, focal deficit, decreased consciousness.

title: Subarachnoid haemorrhage
description: Bleeding into the subarachnoid space, often aneurysmal; sudden 'thunderclap' headache, neck stiffness.

title: Transient ischaemic attack
description: Transient focal neurological deficit resolving within 24 hours without infarction on imaging.

title: Epilepsy
description: Recurrent unprovoked seizures; convulsive episodes, post-ictal confusion, or focal seizure semiology.

title: Status epilepticus
description: Continuous seizure activity or repeated seizures without recovery, lasting over 5 minutes; neurological emergency.

title: Bell's palsy
description: Acute idiopathic unilateral facial nerve palsy including the forehead, distinguishing it from central causes.

title: Multiple sclerosis
description: Demyelinating CNS disease with episodes of neurological dysfunction disseminated in time and space.

title: Parkinson disease
description: Progressive neurodegenerative disorder; resting tremor, bradykinesia, rigidity, postural instability.

title: Trigeminal neuralgia
description: Recurrent brief episodes of severe unilateral facial pain in a trigeminal nerve distribution, often triggered by light touch.

title: Carpal tunnel syndrome
description: Median nerve compression at the wrist; numbness/tingling in the thumb, index, and middle fingers, worse at night.

title: Idiopathic intracranial hypertension
description: Raised intracranial pressure without a mass lesion, typically in obese young women; headache, papilloedema, visual disturbance.

title: Guillain-Barré syndrome
description: Acute post-infectious autoimmune polyneuropathy; ascending symmetric weakness, areflexia.

title: Cerebral palsy, unspecified
description: Non-progressive motor disorder from early brain injury/malformation; abnormal tone, movement, posture.

title: Normal pressure hydrocephalus
description: Triad of gait disturbance, urinary incontinence, and cognitive decline with ventriculomegaly and normal opening pressure.

title: Concussion (mild traumatic brain injury)
description: Transient neurological disturbance after head trauma without structural imaging abnormality.

title: Conjunctivitis
description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva; redness, discharge, gritty sensation, viral/bacterial/allergic.

title: Acute angle-closure glaucoma
description: Sudden rise in intraocular pressure from angle obstruction; severe eye pain, blurred vision, haloes, red eye.

title: Primary open-angle glaucoma
description: Chronic optic neuropathy with gradual peripheral visual field loss, usually asymptomatic until advanced.

title: Age-related cataract
description: Progressive lens opacification; gradual painless blurring of vision, glare sensitivity.

title: Diabetic retinopathy
description: Microvascular retinal damage from chronic hyperglycaemia; may be asymptomatic until vision-threatening stages.

title: Age-related macular degeneration
description: Central retinal degeneration causing progressive central vision loss in older adults.

title: Retinal detachment
description: Separation of retina from underlying tissue; sudden floaters, flashes, curtain-like visual field loss.

title: Uveitis
description: Inflammation of the uveal tract; eye pain, redness, photophobia, blurred vision.

title: Refractive error, myopia
description: Nearsightedness from mismatch of eye optics and axial length; distance vision blurred, near vision preserved.

title: Corneal abrasion
description: Superficial corneal epithelial defect, typically traumatic; pain, foreign body sensation, photophobia, tearing.

title: Otitis externa
description: Infection/inflammation of the external ear canal; ear pain worse with tragal pressure, discharge, itching.

title: Acute otitis media
description: Acute middle ear infection; ear pain, fever, decreased hearing, bulging tympanic membrane.

title: Otitis media with effusion
description: Fluid in the middle ear without acute infection signs; hearing loss, aural fullness, common post-URI in children.

title: Ménière disease
description: Inner ear disorder with episodic vertigo, fluctuating hearing loss, tinnitus, aural fullness.

title: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo
description: Brief episodic vertigo triggered by specific head movements from otolith displacement.

title: Presbycusis
description: Age-related sensorineural hearing loss, bilateral and gradually progressive, high frequencies first.

title: Cerumen impaction
description: Ear wax build-up occluding the canal; hearing loss, fullness, sometimes discomfort or tinnitus.

title: Essential hypertension
description: Persistently elevated blood pressure without identifiable secondary cause; often asymptomatic.

title: Hypertensive emergency
description: Severe hypertension with acute end-organ damage; requires urgent blood pressure reduction.

title: Angina pectoris
description: Exertional or stress-induced chest discomfort from reversible myocardial ischaemia.

title: Acute myocardial infarction
description: Acute coronary ischaemia causing myocardial necrosis; crushing chest pain, diaphoresis, ECG/troponin changes.

title: Atrial fibrillation
description: Irregularly irregular supraventricular tachyarrhythmia; palpitations, fatigue, irregular pulse.

title: Supraventricular tachycardia
description: Regular narrow-complex tachycardia originating above the ventricles; abrupt onset/offset palpitations.

title: Ventricular fibrillation
description: Chaotic ventricular electrical activity with no effective cardiac output; cardiac arrest, requires immediate defibrillation.

title: Deep vein thrombosis
description: Venous thromboembolism typically in the lower limb; unilateral leg swelling, warmth, tenderness.

title: Pulmonary embolism
description: Thromboembolic obstruction of pulmonary arteries; sudden dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, tachycardia, hypoxia.

title: Heart failure
description: Inadequate cardiac output or elevated filling pressures; exertional dyspnea, orthopnea, oedema.

title: Pericarditis, unspecified
description: Inflammation of the pericardium; sharp pleuritic chest pain relieved by sitting forward.

title: Infective endocarditis
description: Infection of the endocardial surface/heart valves; fever, new murmur, embolic phenomena.

title: Rheumatic heart disease
description: Valvular damage following rheumatic fever; murmur, may progress to heart failure over years.

title: Peripheral arterial disease
description: Atherosclerotic narrowing of limb arteries; intermittent claudication, cold extremities, diminished pulses.

title: Aortic aneurysm, abdominal
description: Abdominal aortic dilation; often asymptomatic until rupture, may present as pulsatile abdominal mass.

title: Aortic dissection
description: Tear in the aortic intima; sudden severe tearing chest/back pain, pulse/BP differential between limbs - emergency.

title: Varicose veins of lower extremity
description: Dilated, tortuous superficial veins; aching, heaviness, visible venous distension, worse standing.

title: Orthostatic hypotension
description: Significant blood pressure drop on standing; lightheadedness, presyncope, syncope on positional change.

title: Cardiogenic shock
description: Severe cardiac pump failure causing inadequate tissue perfusion; hypotension, cold extremities, altered mentation.

title: First-degree atrioventricular block
description: Prolonged PR interval on ECG without dropped beats; usually asymptomatic, incidental finding.

title: Acute upper respiratory tract infection, unspecified
description: Common cold syndrome; nasal congestion, sore throat, mild cough, low-grade or no fever.

title: Community-acquired pneumonia
description: Acute lung parenchymal infection acquired outside a healthcare setting; fever, productive cough, focal crackles.

title: Acute bronchitis
description: Self-limited bronchial tree inflammation, usually viral; cough with/without sputum, no focal consolidation.

title: Asthma
description: Chronic inflammatory airway disease with variable reversible obstruction; recurrent wheeze, cough, chest tightness.

title: Status asthmaticus (severe acute asthma exacerbation)
description: Severe asthma attack unresponsive to standard bronchodilators; risk of respiratory failure.

title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
description: Progressive airflow limitation, usually smoking-related; chronic cough, sputum, exertional dyspnea.

title: Acute exacerbation of COPD
description: Acute worsening of COPD symptoms beyond normal day-to-day variation, often infection-triggered.

title: Spontaneous pneumothorax
description: Sudden lung collapse from air in pleural space without trauma; sudden pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea.

title: Pleural effusion, not elsewhere classified
description: Abnormal fluid accumulation in pleural space; dyspnea, dullness to percussion, decreased breath sounds.

title: Bronchiectasis
description: Irreversible bronchial dilation; chronic productive cough with copious sputum, recurrent infections.

title: Croup (acute laryngotracheobronchitis)
description: Viral upper airway inflammation in young children; barking cough, stridor, hoarseness, worse at night.

title: Acute respiratory distress syndrome
description: Acute severe hypoxaemic respiratory failure with bilateral infiltrates, non-cardiogenic pulmonary oedema.

title: Pulmonary fibrosis, idiopathic
description: Progressive interstitial lung scarring; progressive exertional dyspnea, dry cough, bibasal crackles.

title: Pulmonary tuberculosis, bacteriologically confirmed
description: Confirmed active pulmonary TB with positive sputum/culture testing.

title: Sarcoidosis
description: Multisystem granulomatous disease often affecting lungs; may present with cough, dyspnea, or incidental hilar lymphadenopathy.

title: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease
description: Reflux of gastric contents causing troublesome symptoms; retrosternal burning, regurgitation.

title: Peptic ulcer disease
description: Mucosal ulceration of stomach or duodenum; epigastric pain related to meals, may bleed.

title: Acute pancreatitis
description: Acute pancreatic inflammation, often gallstone/alcohol related; severe epigastric pain radiating to back.

title: Acute appendicitis
description: Acute inflammation of the appendix; periumbilical pain migrating to right lower quadrant, fever, rebound.

title: Acute gastroenteritis, presumed infectious
description: Acute diarrhoeal illness with vomiting/cramping, usually self-limited and infectious.

title: Cholelithiasis with acute cholecystitis
description: Gallstone obstructing the cystic duct causing gallbladder inflammation; RUQ pain, positive Murphy's sign, fever.

title: Irritable bowel syndrome
description: Functional bowel disorder with pain related to defecation and altered bowel habits, no structural cause.

title: Acute viral hepatitis, unspecified
description: Acute liver inflammation from viral infection; malaise, nausea, RUQ discomfort, jaundice.

title: Chronic hepatitis B
description: Chronic HBV infection; may be asymptomatic, risk of progression to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.

title: Cirrhosis of liver
description: End-stage fibrotic liver disease; jaundice, ascites, variceal bleeding risk, hepatic encephalopathy.

title: Coeliac disease
description: Gluten-triggered autoimmune enteropathy; diarrhoea, bloating, weight loss, malabsorption, may be subtle.

title: Crohn disease
description: Chronic transmural inflammatory bowel disease, any GI segment; abdominal pain, diarrhoea, weight loss, fistulae.

title: Ulcerative colitis
description: Chronic mucosal inflammatory bowel disease limited to colon; bloody diarrhoea, urgency, tenesmus.

title: Diverticulitis
description: Inflammation of colonic diverticula; left lower quadrant pain, fever, altered bowel habit.

title: Achalasia
description: Oesophageal motility disorder with failure of lower sphincter relaxation; progressive dysphagia to solids and liquids.

title: Acute pharyngitis
description: Throat inflammation, viral or bacterial; sore throat, odynophagia, may have exudate if streptococcal.

title: Acute pancreatitis, gallstone-related
description: Pancreatitis secondary to gallstone migration/obstruction of the pancreatic duct.

title: Chronic pancreatitis
description: Progressive pancreatic fibrosis, often alcohol-related; recurrent epigastric pain, malabsorption, diabetes over time.

title: Haemorrhoids
description: Swollen anal/rectal venous cushions; bright red rectal bleeding, itching, discomfort, may prolapse.

title: Ischaemic colitis
description: Reduced blood flow to the colon; abdominal pain, bloody diarrhoea, typically in older adults with vascular risk factors.

title: Psoriasis
description: Chronic immune-mediated skin disease; well-demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale, extensor surfaces.

title: Atopic dermatitis
description: Chronic relapsing itchy inflammatory skin condition; flexural eczematous rash, often atopy history.

title: Urticaria
description: Transient itchy wheals from mast-cell mediator release; may be allergen, infection, or idiopathic triggered.

title: Contact dermatitis
description: Localized inflammatory skin reaction from irritant or allergen exposure; well-demarcated erythema/vesicles at contact site.

title: Acne vulgaris
description: Chronic follicular skin condition; comedones, papules, pustules, typically face/trunk, adolescent onset.

title: Impetigo
description: Superficial bacterial skin infection, common in children; honey-coloured crusted lesions, highly contagious.

title: Vitiligo
description: Autoimmune destruction of melanocytes; well-demarcated depigmented patches.

title: Alopecia areata
description: Autoimmune hair loss; well-circumscribed patches of non-scarring hair loss.

title: Herpes zoster ophthalmicus
description: Zoster reactivation involving the ophthalmic branch of the trigeminal nerve; vesicular rash on forehead/nose tip with eye involvement risk.

title: Seborrhoeic dermatitis
description: Chronic scaly inflammatory rash of sebaceous areas (scalp, face); erythema with greasy yellowish scale.

title: Angioedema
description: Deep dermal/subcutaneous swelling, often with urticaria; may involve lips, tongue, airway - risk of compromise if laryngeal.

title: Melasma
description: Acquired symmetric hyperpigmentation of sun-exposed facial skin, often pregnancy or hormonally associated.

title: Pressure ulcer
description: Localized skin/tissue injury from sustained pressure, usually over a bony prominence, staged by depth.

title: Scabies
description: Mite infestation causing intense itching, worse at night; burrows in finger webs, wrists, genitals.

title: Tinea corporis
description: Superficial dermatophyte skin infection; annular scaly plaque with central clearing and raised active border.

title: Osteoarthritis
description: Degenerative joint disease from cartilage breakdown; pain worse with activity, morning stiffness under 30 min.

title: Rheumatoid arthritis
description: Autoimmune symmetric polyarthritis; morning stiffness over 1 hour, small joint involvement, positive RF/anti-CCP.

title: Low back pain
description: Pain localized to the lumbar region without red-flag features; mechanical, activity-related, no neuro deficit.

title: Sciatica
description: Radicular leg pain from nerve root irritation, often disc-related; pain radiating below the knee in a dermatomal pattern.

title: Gout
description: Crystal arthropathy from urate deposition; acute severe monoarticular pain, classically the first MTP joint.

title: Pseudogout (calcium pyrophosphate deposition)
description: Crystal arthropathy typically affecting the knee/wrist in older adults; acute monoarticular swelling and pain.

title: Ankylosing spondylitis
description: Chronic inflammatory spondyloarthropathy; inflammatory back pain, worse at night/rest, improves with activity.

title: Fibromyalgia
description: Chronic widespread musculoskeletal pain with fatigue, sleep disturbance, and tender points, no structural cause.

title: Osteoporosis
description: Reduced bone mineral density with fracture risk; often asymptomatic until a fragility fracture occurs.

title: Adhesive capsulitis (frozen shoulder)
description: Progressive painful restriction of shoulder range of motion, often idiopathic or post-immobilization.

title: Plantar fasciitis
description: Inflammation of the plantar fascia; heel pain worse with first steps in the morning or after rest.

title: Septic arthritis
description: Bacterial joint infection; acute hot, swollen, severely painful joint, fever - orthopaedic emergency requiring urgent drainage.

title: Osteomyelitis
description: Bone infection; localized bone pain, fever, may follow trauma, surgery, or haematogenous spread.

title: Rotator cuff tendinopathy
description: Degenerative or overuse injury of rotator cuff tendons; shoulder pain with overhead activity, painful arc.

title: Lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow)
description: Overuse tendinopathy at the lateral elbow; pain with gripping and wrist extension against resistance.

title: Closed fracture of forearm
description: Fracture of radius and/or ulna without skin break; pain, swelling, deformity, point tenderness after trauma.

title: Closed fracture of femur
description: Femoral fracture without skin break; severe pain, deformity, inability to bear weight, high-energy trauma or fragility in elderly.

title: Scoliosis
description: Lateral curvature of the spine; often detected on screening, may be asymptomatic or cause back discomfort.

title: Acute kidney injury
description: Rapid decline in renal function over hours to days; reduced urine output, rising creatinine.

title: Chronic kidney disease
description: Progressive irreversible renal function loss over months to years; fatigue, oedema, hypertension.

title: End-stage renal disease
description: Advanced chronic kidney disease requiring renal replacement therapy (dialysis or transplant).

title: Acute cystitis
description: Lower urinary tract infection confined to the bladder; dysuria, frequency, urgency, no fever/flank pain.

title: Acute pyelonephritis
description: Upper urinary tract infection involving the kidney; fever, flank pain, costovertebral angle tenderness.

title: Nephrolithiasis
description: Kidney stone disease; severe colicky flank pain radiating to groin, haematuria, nausea.

title: Nephrotic syndrome
description: Heavy proteinuria with hypoalbuminaemia and oedema; frothy urine, periorbital/peripheral swelling.

title: Glomerulonephritis
description: Inflammatory glomerular disease; haematuria, proteinuria, hypertension, may follow infection.

title: Benign prostatic hyperplasia
description: Non-cancerous prostate enlargement in ageing men; hesitancy, weak stream, nocturia, incomplete emptying.

title: Acute prostatitis
description: Acute bacterial prostate infection; fever, perineal pain, dysuria, tender prostate on exam.

title: Testicular torsion
description: Twisting of the spermatic cord causing testicular ischaemia; sudden severe scrotal pain, swelling - surgical emergency.

title: Epididymitis
description: Inflammation/infection of the epididymis; gradual scrotal pain and swelling, may relieve with elevation (unlike torsion).

title: Urinary incontinence
description: Involuntary urine leakage; stress, urge, or mixed type depending on triggering mechanism.

title: Polycystic kidney disease
description: Inherited progressive renal cyst formation; hypertension, flank pain, may progress to renal failure.

title: Urinary retention, acute
description: Sudden inability to void; painful bladder distension, often from BPH, obstruction, or medication effect.

title: Erectile dysfunction
description: Persistent inability to achieve/maintain an erection sufficient for satisfactory sexual activity.

title: Chlamydial infection, genital
description: Common sexually transmitted infection; often asymptomatic, may cause discharge, dysuria, pelvic pain.

title: Gonorrhoea
description: Neisseria gonorrhoeae STI; purulent discharge, dysuria, may be asymptomatic especially in women.

title: Syphilis, primary
description: Treponema pallidum infection; painless genital chancre at inoculation site.

title: Pelvic inflammatory disease
description: Upper genital tract infection in women, often STI-related; lower abdominal pain, cervical motion tenderness, fever.

title: Pregnancy, confirmed
description: Confirmed intrauterine pregnancy, routine antenatal presentation without complication.

title: Pre-eclampsia
description: New-onset hypertension after 20 weeks gestation with proteinuria or other end-organ involvement.

title: Eclampsia
description: Seizures occurring in the setting of pre-eclampsia; obstetric emergency.

title: Gestational diabetes mellitus
description: Glucose intolerance with onset/first recognition during pregnancy, identified on OGTT screening.

title: Ectopic pregnancy
description: Implantation outside the uterine cavity, typically tubal; abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, rupture risk.

title: Placental abruption
description: Premature placental separation; sudden abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, uterine tenderness, fetal distress.

title: Placenta praevia
description: Placenta covering or near the cervical os; painless vaginal bleeding, usually in the third trimester.

title: Threatened miscarriage
description: Vaginal bleeding in early pregnancy with a closed cervix and viable pregnancy on ultrasound.

title: Spontaneous miscarriage
description: Loss of pregnancy before viability; cramping, bleeding, passage of products of conception.

title: Hyperemesis gravidarum
description: Severe pregnancy-related nausea and vomiting causing dehydration, weight loss, electrolyte disturbance.

title: Postpartum haemorrhage
description: Excessive bleeding after delivery; obstetric emergency requiring rapid assessment and management.

title: Puerperal sepsis
description: Infection of the genital tract following childbirth; fever, uterine tenderness, foul lochia.

title: Gestational hypertension
description: New hypertension after 20 weeks gestation without proteinuria or other pre-eclampsia features.

title: Obstructed labour
description: Failure of labour progression due to mechanical obstruction; requires urgent obstetric intervention.

title: Preterm newborn
description: Live birth before 37 completed weeks gestation; risk of respiratory, thermoregulatory, feeding complications.

title: Neonatal jaundice
description: Elevated neonatal bilirubin; yellowing of skin/sclera, risk of kernicterus if severe and untreated.

title: Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome
description: Surfactant deficiency in preterm neonates; grunting, retractions, tachypnoea shortly after birth.

title: Neonatal sepsis
description: Systemic infection in the first 28 days of life; temperature instability, poor feeding, lethargy, non-specific signs.

title: Intrauterine growth restriction
description: Fetal growth below expected percentile for gestational age; identified on antenatal growth scans.

title: Birth asphyxia
description: Impaired gas exchange during labour/delivery causing hypoxia; low Apgar scores, need for resuscitation.

title: Congenital heart defect, unspecified
description: Structural cardiac malformation present from birth; may be detected antenatally, at birth, or later in infancy.

title: Cleft lip and palate
description: Congenital facial malformation from incomplete fusion; feeding difficulty, speech implications.

title: Down syndrome (trisomy 21)
description: Chromosomal disorder from an extra copy of chromosome 21; characteristic facial features, developmental delay.

title: Talipes equinovarus (clubfoot)
description: Congenital foot deformity with inward-turned, downward-pointing foot; treated with early correction (e.g. Ponseti method).

title: Fever, unspecified
description: Elevated body temperature without an identified cause at time of presentation.

title: Abdominal pain, unspecified site
description: Abdominal pain without sufficient evidence to localize to a specific organ system diagnosis.

title: Malaise and fatigue
description: Non-specific tiredness or unwellness without a confirmed underlying cause.

title: Syncope
description: Transient loss of consciousness with spontaneous recovery, due to transient global cerebral hypoperfusion.

title: Chest pain, unspecified
description: Chest pain without sufficient evidence to attribute to a specific cardiac, pulmonary, or musculoskeletal cause.

title: Weight loss, unintentional
description: Unexplained loss of body weight, warrants investigation for underlying malignant, endocrine, or GI cause.

title: Dyspnoea
description: Subjective breathlessness without a confirmed underlying diagnosis at time of presentation.

title: Nausea and vomiting
description: Non-specific nausea/vomiting symptom presentation without a confirmed underlying cause.

title: Pallor
description: Pale skin/mucosal appearance noted on exam, prompting workup for anaemia or poor perfusion.

title: Traumatic subdural haematoma
description: Bleeding between dura and brain following head trauma; may present with delayed decline in consciousness.

title: Burn, unspecified degree, unspecified body region
description: Thermal skin injury; severity assessed by depth and body surface area involved.

title: Superficial injury, abrasion
description: Minor skin-surface injury without deeper tissue involvement; localized pain, minimal bleeding.

title: Ankle sprain
description: Ligamentous injury of the ankle, usually inversion mechanism; swelling, bruising, pain with weight-bearing.

title: Laceration, open wound
description: Break in skin integrity from trauma; assessed for depth, contamination, involvement of deeper structures.

title: Poisoning by paracetamol
description: Paracetamol overdose; may be asymptomatic initially, risk of delayed hepatotoxicity, requires level and treatment protocol.

title: Snakebite envenoming
description: Venomous snakebite; local swelling/necrosis and/or systemic coagulopathy or neurotoxicity depending on species.

title: Near-drowning
description: Submersion injury with respiratory impairment survived beyond the initial event; risk of delayed pulmonary complications.

title: Frostbite
description: Cold-induced tissue injury; numbness, pallor, hardness of affected tissue, risk of tissue loss if severe.

title: Heat stroke
description: Severe heat illness with core temperature elevation and CNS dysfunction; medical emergency.

title: Encounter for general adult health check-up
description: Routine preventive health examination without a presenting complaint.

title: Contact with and exposure to communicable disease
description: Known exposure to an infectious contact, used for surveillance/prophylaxis decisions, no active symptoms.

title: Family history of malignant neoplasm
description: Documented family history used for risk stratification, not an active diagnosis.

title: Problems related to housing and economic circumstances
description: Social determinant of health documentation, e.g. housing instability, affecting care planning.

title: Immunization status, routine
description: Encounter primarily for vaccination, no active illness.

title: Qi deficiency pattern (traditional medicine)
description: Traditional medicine pattern of fatigue, weakness, and low vitality; used alongside, not in place of, biomedical diagnosis.
